items.title: Big Buck Bunny
items.plot: A gentle giant of a rabbit has his quiet morning ruined by three bullying rodents, and sets out on an elaborate, very funny revenge.

items.title: Elephants Dream
items.plot: Two strange men, Emo and Proog, explore a vast mechanical world that one of them insists he built, and that may exist only in his head.

items.title: Sintel
items.plot: A lonely young woman raises a baby dragon she calls Scales. When an adult dragon carries it off, she spends years crossing a dangerous land to find it.

items.title: Tears of Steel
items.plot: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of warriors and scientists try to save the world by replaying a painful moment from one man's past.

items.title: Cosmos Laundromat
items.plot: On a desolate island a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a mysterious salesman, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. Or several lifetimes.

items.title: Hero
items.plot: A short showcase of Blender's Grease Pencil: a hand-drawn duel told in bold strokes of red and blue.

items.title: Spring
items.plot: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits to bring the cycle of life back to the mountains.

commons.fanart: File:Blender Foundation - Spring - Closing title card.jpg

items.title: Sprite Fright
items.plot: Teenagers on a forest trip learn that the tiny, adorable sprites living there are far less friendly than they look.

items.title: Charge
items.plot: In a world running out of energy, an old man breaks into a heavily guarded charging station for one last battery.

items.title: Caminandes
items.plot: Koro, a stubborn llama in Patagonia, keeps finding new ways to get himself into trouble.

episodes.title: Llama Drama
episodes.plot: Koro meets a road he cannot cross, and refuses to give up.

episodes.title: Gran Dillama
episodes.plot: Koro finds grass on the other side of a wire fence.

episodes.title: Llamigos
episodes.plot: Koro and a penguin named Oti fight over the last berries of winter.
